chunks: Ahmad ibn Muhammad, from 'Ali ibn al-Hakam, from Sayf ibn 'Umayrah, from Sulayman ibn Harun, who said:
I asked Abu al-Hasan عليه السلام about making up the prayer after al-'Asr. He said: Then make it up whenever you wish.

key_terms.أَبَا الْحَسَنِ: Abu al-Hasan, the Imam addressed in the narration
key_terms.الصَّلَاةِ: the prayer being discussed for make-up
key_terms.بَعْدَ الْعَصْرِ: after the time of al-'Asr prayer
key_terms.فَاقْضِهَا: then perform it as a make-up
key_terms.قَضَاءِ: making up or performing a missed act of worship later
key_terms.مَتَى مَا شِئْتَ: whenever you wish; at any time you choose

ai.seo_question: Can a missed prayer be made up after al-'Asr?
ai.summary: This hadith gives a legal ruling concerning the make-up of a missed prayer after al-'Asr. Abu al-Hasan عليه السلام states that it may be performed whenever one wishes, indicating permissibility in its timing.
